title: Equilibrium Dynamics and Mitigation of Gender Bias in Synthetically Generated Data

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using a three-pronged approach: 1) a rule-based metric that measures stereotypical co-occurrences between gendered pronouns and occupation terms; 2) an embedding-based metric computing cosine similarity between generated text embeddings and gender prototype vectors; and 3) a downstream evaluation training logistic regression classifiers on instruction embeddings to predict gender associations.
